hints.title: Bit Inspection Loop
hints.text: Inspect each bit from index 0 upward by checking the least significant bit and shifting right.

hints.title: Index Parity Separation
hints.text: If the current bit is 1, increment the even counter when the bit index is even, and the odd counter when it is odd.

hints.title: Termination Condition
hints.text: Continue shifting until n becomes 0, then return [even, odd].

hints.title: Bit Parity Counting Implementation

complexity.notes: At most 30 bit shifts for n <= 1000.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: String conversion is slower than direct bit shifts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Extracts bits with bitwise shifts and tracks index parity.
